phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.83: New StreamFlix-style structure. Clean top nav (Home / Live TV / Movies / Series / Search / Settings), a cinematic hero banner on Home, then content rails in order — Live TV, Trending Movies, Popular Series, New Releases, Bollywood, Hollywood. Movies & Series screens now have genre chips and a sort control (Popular / Newest / A-Z) like Apple TV. Carries all earlier fixes: corner Options seek, OTT logos, un-mixed categories, Settings + Live D-pad nav.
